notes: SLOT 16 (03:05 IST fire / 2026-09-21 21:35 UTC) - WORK SLOT. Item 51 again, same honesty-defect class as the slot-6 telephony badges but on the gateway control itself. src/components/PermissionGateway.tsx - the screen a human reads before approving an irreversible Level 4 action - drove its emergency badge, lockout banner and approval button from emergency.emergencyPaused alone, seeded that state as { emergencyPaused: false }, and fetched /api/emergency/status inside the SAME try block as the approval queue lists. A failed status request was therefore swallowed, the initial 'not paused' value stood, and the UI showed a green ACTIVE pill, no banner, and an ENABLED 'YES / APPROVE & EXECUTE' button on the strength of a value nobody had fetched. Any payload whose emergencyPaused was not a boolean also fell through to the green branch. Fix: new pure, dependency-free tri-state src/utils/emergencyTruth.ts - emergencyLiveness() returns ACTIVE | ENGAGED | UNKNOWN (UNKNOWN until a real boolean is observed), plus emergencyStatusKnown() and emergencyLivenessLabel(). PermissionGateway.tsx seeds emergency as null, fetches the status in its own try block whose failure leaves liveness at UNKNOWN (can no longer silently resolve to 'not paused'), renders an explicit STATUS UNKNOWN badge with a matching banner, and derives approvalBlocked = killSwitchEngaged || !statusKnown - the Level 4 approve button is disabled={loading || approvalBlocked} and handleApprove() returns early when !statusKnown. No render path reads emergency.emergencyPaused any more. New test src/tests/permissionGatewayEmergencyLiveness.test.ts (9 cases): tri-state for null/undefined/missing-boolean/paused/hard-switch, emergencyStatusKnown, unobserved status never ACTIVE, labels, and source guards pinning the null seed, derived approvalBlocked, fail-closed !statusKnown early return and absence of the raw flag read. Negative validation: restoring a single raw read (disabled={loading || emergency.emergencyPaused || killSwitchEngaged}) fails exactly the source guard, observed 1 failed | 8 passed of 9; restored -> 9 passed.
